title: Email or chat message with a request
when_to_use: An email or chat message that asks its readers to do something by a date.
facts_hint: paste the facts the message states (dates, numbers, links)

personas.description: Busy reader who gets many messages a day, reads this one between meetings, and decides whether to act on it now.

dimensions.name: The ask
dimensions.question: After one read, can the persona say what is asked, by when, and how small the first step is?

anchors.1: no request, or a request with no action and no date
anchors.3: the action is named, but the date or the size of the first step is missing
anchors.5: one concrete action, a date, and the effort of the first step are stated in the first lines

dimensions.name: Relevance to the persona
dimensions.question: Is the reason to act stated in terms the persona already tracks?

anchors.1: the reason to act would read the same for any reader
anchors.3: the reason is stated in the persona's own terms, without a number they can check
anchors.5: the reason is stated in the persona's own terms with one number they can check

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.question: Is each claim the ask depends on backed by a number or a named case consistent with the facts?

anchors.1: no claim the ask depends on carries a number or a named case
anchors.3: one claim the ask depends on is backed, another is only asserted
anchors.5: every claim the ask depends on carries a number or a named case consistent with the facts

dimensions.name: Brevity
dimensions.question: Does every sentence serve the ask?

anchors.1: most sentences could be cut without loss
anchors.3: a few sentences could be cut without loss
anchors.5: no sentence could be cut without losing something the persona needs

measured.description: word count of the message, 150 or fewer
